hooks.name: TechLead No Source Write
hooks.description: Blocks the TechLead orchestrator from writing/editing source code in src/ — that work belongs to subagents

action.prompt: You are the TechLead orchestrator. Writing or editing source files (src/**/*.cs) is forbidden — that is subagent work. If you need to implement a change, dispatch a workflow agent to do it. Only AGENTS.md and .kiro/** files are allowed for direct editing. If this write call targets a src/**/*.cs file, stop and delegate to a subagent instead.
